intro.title: DATA LINK
intro.text: Link your male and female route clear records from Super Robot Wars Z to earn Funds, PP and other bonuses at the start of each Story Mode episode. To link data, insert a PS2 memory card containing Super Robot Wars Z system data into MEMORY CARD slot 1.
intro.question: Link the data?

intro.title: ANOTHER SIDE RECORD
intro.text: While ZEUTH fought the Hundred Demon Empire in Japan after leaving Siberia, the New Federation formed a task force under Col. Neo Roanoke. Recruits came from the military and civilian allies. What is their special mission, and who is the enemy they pursue? Amid these mysteries, their battle begins.
intro.question: Play this episode?

intro.title: BACKSTORY MEMORY
intro.text: ZEUTH has seized the UN Station, now a Chimera fortress, and revealed the hidden truth to the world. Only ten hours remain to save Eureka, now the Command Cluster, and repair space-time. As they renew their resolve for the final battle, the members look back on their days of fighting.
intro.question: Play this episode?

intro.title: GLORY STAR REPORT
intro.text: Entrusted with the mission by the late Capt. Denzel Hammer, Star 3 records every operation to complete the Virgola. This excerpt from her report covers ZEUTH's battles between meeting Brig. Gen. Edel Bernal at the New Federation's Tampagunda Base and reaching ZAFT's Gibraltar Base.
intro.question: Play this episode?

intro.title: BEATER SERVICE LOG
intro.text: Mail Beater keeps the wandering repair shop Beater Service's work log, known as the Memory Notebook. Its scope now extends beyond the shop to all of ZEUTH. This excerpt records their battles while sheltering at Tresor Research after the New Federation coup.
intro.question: Play this episode?

intro.title: SECRET EPILOGUE
intro.text: ZEUTH's efforts repaired space-time and saved the Multiverse from collapse. Yet a dark shadow threatens to lead the world to ruin. Sensing trouble, ZEUTH reunites to fight for the future they risked their lives to protect. What is this new threat? Can they save the world?
intro.question: Play this episode?

challenge: To retake the colony laser seized by Axis, Bright sends the Argama ahead alone. As a decoy for the allied assault, it must weaken the enemy Gaza-C force. Destroy at least 100 enemy units within four minutes. Complete the mission with the Argama and seven mobile suits.

The Hundred Demon Empire's trump card, Science Fortress Island, advances on Japan. Only one massive strike can stop it before it reaches the New Saotome Lab. You have one chance. Unite the Mazinger and Getter teams to crush Emperor Burai's ambition and the fortress.

Seeking a way to communicate with the Coralians, Gekkostate heads for Vodara Temple, the Vodarac's holy site. The military moves to wipe out the Vodarac. Refusing to repeat his past mistake, Holland vows to defend the temple with his life, and his crew follows. Can they hold off the approaching KLFs?

Jiron Amos and the Iron Gear crew rise against bandits ravaging the Bazaar. Pride, stubbornness and bounty hunting mix in a wild chase across Zola. The goal: earn 350000 Funds. For the sake of survival, it's time to put those bandits in their place!

Siberian Rail throws a huge force at Yapan's Ceiling to stop its Exodus. Outnumbered, Gain targets the commanders: Yassaba, Kashimaru and Asuham. All three pilot powerful Overmen. Rally every force at Yapan's Ceiling and destroy those three Overmen within the time limit.

Ghingnham, Timp, Sting, Yazan, Gagarn, Alex and Kizz Munt unite in Antarctica. To prevent the return of the Black History, Jamil and Dianna send a force to stop their ambitions. You have nine minutes. Defeat every enemy before history repeats itself.

Durandal declares the Destiny Plan in effect. For the world's future, the Archangel and Eternal fight ZAFT to open a path to Messiah. You have four minutes. Evade Shinn, Rey and their allies, and destroy at least 150 mobile suits defending the fortress.

King Beal locates Bandock. Heizaemon judges that a weak attack will only make the playful Butcher retreat, and plans to destroy Bandock in one blow. First, wipe out the surrounding Mecha Boosts to draw it out. You have just one chance: destroy Bandock with a single strike.

The Glomar finds an Emaan caravan under Chiram attack. Though pursued by the Emaan, Kei and his friends offer help, only to be refused. They follow their hearts and face the Chiram anyway. Without the caravan's cooperation, can the Glomar protect it from the approaching enemy?

The Frieden finds unmanned mobile suits running wild after an autopilot malfunction. Garrod's group sorties to help people and raise Funds, but the Frost brothers approach. Can the crew evade their attacks, destroy every enemy within the time limit and earn the target 450000 Funds?

An accident leaves the main pilots unable to sortie. Hola, Hidler, Scirocco, Kashimaru, Cynthia, Anemone and Alan join forces and attack. With pride and determination, the remaining pilots sortie to protect their friends. Can they defeat these enemy aces with limited strength and time?

The alien alliance commits its full force to annihilate humanity with its trump card, Goma. Shadow Angels join the attack. Earth's defenders have nine minutes to destroy this entire mighty force. With enemies stronger than ever approaching, what fate awaits Earth?

Out-of-control Zeravire attack indiscriminately. Sandman vows to destroy them, and righteous forces gather from across the world, yet the enemy is overwhelming: 100 Zeravire, and only three minutes. Failure means Earth's devastation. Can these forces sweep away the darkness?

The diabolical artificial sun is deployed again. Unless it is destroyed within five minutes, Antarctica's ice will melt and flood Earth: the first step toward turning it into Planet S-1. The artificial sun is your only target. Rally every force in the little time left to save Earth's tomorrow.

Dropping Orange brings forth antibody Coralians. They attack humans on instinct, leaving no choice but to fight. Following Holland's painful decision, the group forms a line to protect the city. Hold it for five minutes until the antibodies reach their activity limit. Do not let even one through.

Bandits use unmanned mobile suits to commit every kind of crime. The group sets out to help people and make a profit, but Federation troops also arrive to suppress the bandits. Letting them help would reduce the earnings. Defeat the bandits first and reach the target: 800000 Funds.

Beyond the heavy defenses wait Scirocco, Haman, Ghingnham and the Frost brothers. Breaking through has exhausted your forces; your mothership, the base of your tactics, is outside the area. Only five minutes remain. Against such powerful aces, can you win from this desperate position?

All foes gather at Atlandia: aliens, demons, Chiram, Breakers, Siberian Rail, Federation, Moonrace, The Big, Shadow Angels, Chimera and its allies. To save the world, face their leaders, ultimate weapons and aces head-on. Only twelve minutes remain against this unprecedented force. Can your united strength win?
